DO NOT SCALE DRAWINGS FOR CONSTRUCTION PURPOSES. IN THE EVENT OF OMISSION OF NECESSARY DIMENSION(S),
NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING.
ALL DIMENSIONS ON 1/8", & 1/4" SCALE PLANS ARE TO THE FACE OF MASONRY, CONCRETE, OR THE FACE OF GYPSUM
BOARD, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. ALL MASONRY DIMENSIONS ARE ACTUAL, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
VERIFY ALL DIMENSIONS, CONDITIONS, EXISTING CONSTRUCTION, AND GRADES AT THE JOB SITE. NOTIFY ARCHITECT IN
WRITING OF ANY DISCREPANCIES OR CONFLICTS.
VERIFY SIZE, LOCATION, AND CHARACTERISTICS OF ALL WORK AND EQUIPMENT TO BE INSTALLED OR RELOCATED
WHETHER FURNISHED BY OWNER OR BY CONTRACTOR(S) BEFORE ANY CONSTRUCTION PERTAINING TO SAME HAS
BEGUN.
VERIFY AND COORDINATE THE SIZE AND LOCATION OF ALL THE OPENINGS FOR STRUCTURAL, MECHANICAL, &
ELECTRICAL WORK AND EQUIPMENT WITH ALL TRADES INVOLVED.
DEMOLITION INFORMATION IS SHOWN THROUGHOUT THE DRAWINGS AND IS NOT LIMITED TO THE DEMOLITION
DRAWINGS.
COORDINATE VISUAL APPEARANCE OF ALL ELECTRICAL, MECHANICAL, & PLUMBING WORK AT AREAS W/ EXPOSED
CEILING/STRUCTURE. RUN ALL PIPES, CONDUITS, DUCTWORK, ETC., ORTHOGONAL WITH STRUCTURE W/ ALL TURNS &
BENDS AT 90 DEGREES.
VERIFY THAT REQUIRED OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE CLEARANCES ARE PROVIDED FOR ALL EQUIPMENT ITEMS.
INSTALL ALL ITEMS IN ACCORDANCE W/ THE MANUFACTURER'S WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS, EXCEPT THAT THE
SPECIFICATIONS HEREIN, WHERE MORE STRINGENT, SHALL SUPERCEDE. NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING OF ANY
CONFLICTS.
COORDINATE WORK OF ALL TRADES TO PROVIDE COMPLETE AND CONTINUOUS ASSEMBLIES, INCLUDING FLASHING, AIR
BARRIERS, WATERPROOFING, AND FIRESTOPPING.
MAINTAIN CONTINUITY OF AIR, WATER, AND THERMAL BARRIERS ACROSS ALL TRANSITIONS, PENETRATIONS, AND
CHANGES IN MATERIALS.
SEAL ALL PENETRATIONS THROUGH EXTERIOR WALLS, ROOFS, AND FIRE-RESISTANCE–RATED ASSEMBLIES TO MAINTAIN
REQUIRED PERFORMANCE. PROVIDE SLEEVES WHERE PIPING OR CONDUITS PENETRATE MASONRY OR CONCRETE.
ISOLATE DISSIMILAR METALS WITH NON-CONDUCTIVE MATERIALS TO PREVENT GALVANIC CORROSION.
PROTECT ADJACENT CONSTRUCTION AND FINISHED SURFACES DURING OPERATIONS. REPAIR OR REPLACE DAMAGED
WORK AT NO ADDITIONAL COST TO THE OWNER.
PROVIDE CORROSION-RESISTANT FASTENERS COMPATIBLE WITH ADJOINING MATERIALS AND EXPOSURE CONDITIONS.
SUBSTITUTIONS ARE NOT PERMITTED WITHOUT PRIOR WRITTEN APPROVAL FROM THE ARCHITECT/OWNER.
DO NOT INSTALL EXTERIOR MATERIALS UNDER CONDITIONS OUTSIDE MANUFACTURER’S TEMPERATURE, MOISTURE, OR
WEATHER LIMITATIONS.
REPAIR AND RESTORE ALL DISTURBED OR DAMAGED AREAS TO MATCH EXISTING CONDITIONS. REMOVE DEBRIS, CLEAN
ALL SURFACES, AND DELIVER THE COMPLETED WORK IN A CLEAN, NEAT, AND FULLY OPERATIONAL CONDITION.
ALL NEW PVC STORM LINES TO DRAIN AT 1/8" MINIMUM SLOPE.
CONTRACTOR TO FIELD VERIFY ALL UTILITIES IN THE VICINITY OF WORK. INFORM THE ARCHITECT IF ANY CONFLICTS
ARE FOUND WHEN INSTALLING THE NEW ROOF DRAIN LINES.
PROVIDE CEMENT STABILIZED SAND EMBEDMENT AROUND STORM LINES AS PER CITY OF HOUSTON 'STORM SEWER
BEDDING AND BACKFILL FOR DRY STABLE TRENCH' DETAILS.

1. CONTRACTOR IS ADVISED THAT RELIANCE ON THESE DESCRIPTIONS ARE AT THE CONTRACTOR'S OWN RISK AND
SUBJECT TO CONTRACTORS' OWN SITE VERIFICATION.
2. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL NOTIFY THE DESIGNER OF UNEXPECTED CONDITIONS OR DETERIORATED SUBSTRATE
MATERIAL IS DISCOVERED.
3. THE WORK INCLUDES ALL LABOR, MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT, AND COORDINATION REQUIRED TO REROUTE
EXISTING INTERNAL ROOF DRAINS TO EXTERIOR DISCHARGE LOCATIONS, INCLUDING VERIFICATION OF EXISTING
CONDITIONS; REMOVAL, ABANDONMENT, OR CAPPING OF EXISTING ROOF DRAIN PIPING; INSTALLATION OF NEW
EXTERIOR ROOF DRAIN COLLECTOR BOXES, PIPING, FITTINGS, SUPPORTS, AND ACCESSORIES; MODIFICATION, REPAIR,
AND RESTORATION OF WALL ASSEMBLIES, PENETRATIONS, SLEEVES, FLASHING, AND SEALS TO MAINTAIN
WATERTIGHT CONSTRUCTION AND CONTINUOUS AIR AND WATER BARRIERS; CONNECTION TO EXISTING STORM
DRAINAGE SYSTEMS WITH POSITIVE DRAINAGE AWAY FROM THE BUILDING; TESTING OF COMPLETED WORK; AND
RESTORATION OF ALL AFFECTED SURFACES TO MATCH EXISTING CONDITIONS, IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPLICABLE
CODES AND OWNER REQUIREMENTS.
4. PROVIDE UNIT PRICING FOR THE FOLLOWING ITEMS, COMPLETE AND INSTALLED, INCLUDING ALL LABOR,
MATERIALS, EQUIPMENT, FASTENERS, INCIDENTALS, CUTTING, PATCHING, TESTING, CLEANING, AND RESTORATION
REQUIRED TO DELIVER A CLEAN, CODE-COMPLIANT, AND FULLY OPERATIONAL SYSTEM:
-PER LINEAR FOOT OF 8" DIAMETER PVC PIPING, INSULATED
-PER LINEAR FOOT OF 6" DIAMETER PVC PIPING, INSULATED
-EACH 8" × 6" ECCENTRIC REDUCER
-EACH PVC LOW-SWEEP ELBOW
-EACH PVC COUPLING
-EACH PIPE HANGER (INCLUDING RODS, INSERTS, ANCHORS, AND STRUCTURAL ATTACHMENT)
-EACH PVC CLEANOUT (INCLUDING ACCESS COVER)
-EACH PIPE PENETRATION THROUGH WALL OR FLOOR (INCLUDING SLEEVE, SEALING, AND FIRESTOPPING AS REQ.)
-EACH FIELD CUT AND RECONNECTION TO EXISTING PIPING
-PER LINEAR FOOT OF PIPE INSULATION REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT
-PER SQUARE FOOT OF CEILING TILE REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT, MATCH EXISTING
-PER LINEAR FOOT OF T-GRID REPAIR OR REPLACEMENT
-PER SQUARE FOOT OF GYPSUM BOARD PATCH AND FINISH, MATCH EXISTING
